munit:test.name: maps-azure-invoice-result-for-po-45188
munit:test.description: A real Azure prebuilt-invoice result for PO 45188 maps to the extraction contract

munit:test.name: reads-lines-from-table-when-items-are-merged
munit:test.description: PO 7795: Azure merged all rows into one invoice item; lines come from the detected table

munit-tools:assert-that.expression: #[payload.lines[0].quantity == 30 and payload.lines[2].quantity == 200 and payload.lines[0].unitPrice == 22 and payload.lines[1].unitPrice == 9.8]

munit:test.name: falls-back-to-invoice-items-without-a-table
munit:test.description: Without a line-item table, lines come from the invoice Items field

munit:payload.value: #[output application/java --- do { var r = readUrl('classpath://azure-invoice-po-45188.json', 'application/json') --- r update { case t at .analyzeResult.tables -> [] } }]

munit:test.name: maps-email-body-order
munit:test.description: An order written in the email body (prompt template answer, with code fences) maps to the extraction contract

munit:test.name: received-at-uses-the-date-header-offset
munit:test.description: 11:14 p.m. Eastern becomes 03:14 UTC the next day; a bad header falls back to now

set-payload.value: #[%dw 2.0 import receivedIso from modules::EmailDates output application/java --- { eastern: receivedIso('Fri, 30 Oct 2026 23:14:34 -0400 (EDT)'), utc: receivedIso('31 Oct 2026 03:14:34 +0000'), bad: receivedIso('not a date') }]

munit:test.name: picks-the-po-document-and-azure-model
munit:test.description: PDF first, then images, then Word/Excel (layout model); other files are ignored

set-payload.value: #[%dw 2.0 import * from modules::Documents output application/java --- { pdfFirst: poDocument([{ name: 'logo.png' }, { name: 'PO-7803.xlsx' }, { name: 'PO-7803.pdf' }]).name, imageOverOffice: poDocument([{ name: 'PO.docx' }, { name: 'scan.JPG' }]).readMode, office: poDocument([{ name: 'notes.txt' }, { name: 'PO-7803-Cobalt.xlsx' }]), none: poDocument([{ name: 'notes.txt' }]), docxType: contentType('PO-7804-Cobalt.docx') }]

munit:test.name: message-key-is-url-safe
munit:test.description: Gmail Message-IDs become a stable, URL-safe SHA-1 key

set-payload.value: #[%dw 2.0 import SHA1 from dw::Crypto output application/java --- 'gm-' ++ SHA1('<CAOdUkAHw+YL/CtQ=@mail.gmail.com>' as Binary)]

munit:test.name: sender-display-name-is-stripped
munit:test.description: Display Name <address> becomes the bare address

set-payload.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java var fromRaw = 'Maya Chen – Brightline Manufacturing <Demo.Dealer.PO+brightline@gmail.com>' var fromAddress = if (fromRaw contains '<') ((fromRaw match /.*<([^>]+)>.*/)[1] default fromRaw) else fromRaw --- lower(trim(fromAddress))]

munit:test.description: An HTML-only email body becomes plain text plus the attachment list

set-payload.value:
